name: SysMain
reason: Preloads programs into RAM (Superfetch). Consumes disk and CPU in games with no benefit on SSDs.

name: WSearch
reason: Windows search indexer. High background disk usage; disabling frees up I/O.

name: DiagTrack
reason: Microsoft Telemetry (Connected User Experiences). Sends telemetry data and uses CPU/network.

name: dmwappushservice
reason: Device management wireless application protocol push service. Unnecessary for gaming.

name: DiagSvc
reason: Diagnostic execution service. Can be re-enabled if diagnostic tools are needed.

name: DPS
reason: Diagnostic Policy Service. Disabling has zero negative impact on gaming.

name: WdiServiceHost
reason: Diagnostic Service Host.

name: WdiSystemHost
reason: System Diagnostic Host.

name: RetailDemo
reason: Retail Demo service. Completely unused outside retail stores.

name: WMPNetworkSvc
reason: Windows Media Player Network Sharing Service.

name: WerSvc
reason: Windows Error Reporting. Disabling reduces network activity on app crashes.

name: MapsBroker
reason: Downloaded Maps Manager. Disable if offline maps are not used.

name: PhoneSvc
reason: Phone service. Disable if phone link features are not used.

name: WalletService
reason: Windows Wallet Service.

name: Spooler
reason: Print Spooler. Disable if no printers are connected.

name: bthserv
reason: Bluetooth Support Service. Disable if Bluetooth devices are not used.

name: BthAvctpSvc
reason: Bluetooth Audio Video Control Transport Protocol Service.

name: XblAuthManager
reason: Xbox Live Auth Manager. Keep enabled if using Xbox App / Game Pass.

name: XblGameSave
reason: Xbox Live Game Save. Keep enabled if using Xbox Game Pass cloud saves.

name: XboxNetApiSvc
reason: Xbox Live Networking Service.

name: XboxGipSvc
reason: Xbox Accessory Management Service.

name: wuauserv
reason: Windows Update. Disabling prevents background updates during gaming, but pauses OS security patches.

name: BITS
reason: Background Intelligent Transfer Service. Uses background network bandwidth for updates.

name: dosvc
reason: Delivery Optimization. Shares updates with other PCs on local network/Internet.

name: nsi
reason: Network Store Interface Service. Disabling affects system network state.
